mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% within the last three months signals an improving labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over the last two quarters indicates strong economic demand, which drives corporate earnings and results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where GDP is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% within the last month signals a contraction in supply, leading to increased prices and reduced corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts by more than 5% within the last two months signals a strengthening demand for housing, which boosts related industries and overall economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4.5% and the CPI is increasing by more than 0.3% month-over-month, the combination signals an inflationary environment with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: inflationary period with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.2% within the last month, it signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200,000 and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real retail and food services sales over the last two months indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS is increasing.
